source_row.rationale: MCV stands for mean corpuscular volume and measures the average size of red blood cells. It is one of the red-cell indices used to help classify anemia.
source_row.source_detail: Definition of MCV as average red blood cell size Source has no separate formal version identifier in the cited page metadata; live currentness and applicability rechecked 2026-08-15.
